d: STRUCTURAL integrates technology-driven solutions with specialty contracting services to improve, protect, and enhance the existing infrastructure of owners directly, and in partnership with designers and contractors. STRUCTURAL offers a wide range of specialty repair and maintenance services and is the largest concrete repair contractor in the United States, with roughly 2,500 employees working from locations nationwide and in select international markets. STRUCTURAL is the open-shop contracting business line of Structural Group.

We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our team based in Abu Dhabi. This role focuses on self-performed structural and concrete restoration work across a range of complex projects that enhance the durability and longevity of critical infrastructure and commercial structures.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
2+ years of progressive estimating experience, with strong preference for candidates experienced in self-performed concrete restoration, structural repair, or specialty contracting.
Experience managing multiple estimates concurrently, including mentoring or supporting junior estimators.

Demonstrated advanced expertise in concrete repair and restoration methodologies, productivity-driven estimating for self-performed work, construction contract analysis and risk allocation, and a comprehensive understanding of the UAE construction market, including pricing dynamics and key stakeholder relationships.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, industry-standard estimating software (e.g., OST, Bluebeam, or similar), and the interpretation of construction drawings and specifications.

STRUCTURAL is committed to a Safety 24/7 culture and offers competitive compensation and benefits including medical, dental insurance, 401(k), paid holidays & vacation, tuition reimbursement, career development and growth opportunities, and a caring work environment. EOE/M/F/D/V
r: As a Construction Estimator, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of estimating and preconstruction activities, including:

Preparing comprehensive cost estimates by performing detailed quantity takeoffs, applying labor productivity and production rate analysis, procuring material and equipment pricing, soliciting and evaluating subcontractor proposals, and integrating all project cost components into a complete and accurate estimate.

Developing conceptual, budgetary, and final bid estimates while defining and quantifying project scope based on drawings, specifications, and site conditions to ensure full scope coverage and risk identification.
Developing preliminary construction schedules, including sequencing, phasing, and duration assumptions, to support pricing accuracy and bid strategy.
Leading bid review meetings with internal stakeholders to align on pursuit strategy, validate pricing assumptions, and ensure comprehensive and accurate final submissions.
Developing comprehensive proposals, including clearly defined scopes of work, project approach, and detailed inclusions and exclusions to ensure clarity, completeness, and risk mitigation.
Proactively engaging with clients and industry partners throughout the bid process to obtain feedback, strengthen relationships, and support ongoing business development efforts.
Collaborating with operations, project management, and field teams to ensure smooth project handoff.
